chinese: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
天之道，不争而善胜，不言而善应，不召而自来，𦈎然而善谋。
pinyin: Yǒng yú gǎn zé shā， yǒng yú bù gǎn zé huó。
Cǐ liǎng zhě， huò lì huò hài。
Tiān zhī suǒ è， shú zhī qí gù？
Shì yǐ shèng rén yóu nán zhī。
Tiān zhī dào， bù zhēng ér shàn shèng， bù yán ér shàn yīng， bù zhào ér zì lái， 𦈎 rán ér shàn móu。
Tiān wǎng huī huī， shū ér bù shī。
english: Being over bold and confident is deadly. The wise use of caution will keep you alive.
One is the way to death, and the other is the way to preserve your life. Who can understand the workings of Heaven?
The Tao of the universe does not compete, yet wins; does not speak, yet responds; does not command, yet is obeyed; and does act, but is good at directing.
The nets of Heaven are wide, but nothing escapes its grasp.
